claims.statement: Billy Carroll backed Tom Allen at one time against Jem Mace for stakes printed as '5H.' a side.
claims.excerpt:
whom he backed at one time against
Jem Mace for 5H. a side.

notes: Obituary of Billy Carroll. The amount is garbled ('5H.'), so the hinted $5,000 is not confirmed by the text. Whether the Allen-Mace match was ever fought is not stated.
